newsitem.title: USA: Morrison Knudsen wins two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Morrison Knudsen wins two contracts.

text.p: Morrison Knudsen Corp said Friday its Envronmental/Government Group has received two contracts.

The first contract, for additional work at Bunker Hill in North Idaho, is a $50-million extension to the Remedial Action Contract awarded by the Walla Walla District of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers in 1994. The extension brings the total contract value to $100 million.

In New Mexico, MK is part of a limited liability company headed by Johnson Controls Inc that has been selected by the University of California to provide support services at the Department of Energy's Los Alamos National Laboratory.

The five-year contract, valued at $77 million per year, was awarded to Johnson Controls Northern New Mexico L.L.C., a partnership of Johnson Controls, Morrison, Jacobs Engineering Group Inc and Duke Engineering and Services. The contract includes an option for five additional years.
Morrison primarily will provide construction-management services for the partnership.
